title: Drunk Boyfriend Beater Resists Arrest & Wrestles Cops on Christmas Eve
description:
On December 24th, 2023, early morning Christmas Eve, officers in Ohio were called to a residence following a report of a female refusing to leave the residence. Upon speaking with both parties, the female told the officers the male resident allegedly sells “crack.” The female suspect appeared to be under the influence and refused to listen to officers' orders to leave the house.

The situation quickly escalated when the suspect, in a fit of rage, hurled a shampoo bottle at the male resident, striking him in the head. Attempts to arrest the suspect were met with resistance as she vehemently refused to cooperate with the officers' instructions.

The confrontation intensified as the suspect shouted threats toward the homeowner. Officers placed the suspect in the handcuffs as she resisted officers lying on the floor screaming. The suspect continued her defiance and disruptive behavior as she was escorted to the patrol car for transport. The suspect was charged with Disorderly Conduct and Resisting Arrest.
